videos.caption: Ordering furniture from China isn’t as simple as finding a cute sofa on Alibaba and hitting “add to cart.” 😂 There’s a whole process between finding the furniture and having that container sitting at your warehouse. Manufacturers. Negotiations. Production. Freight. Customs. Port fees. Final delivery. And baby… there are PLENTY of opportunities to make an expensive mistake in between. Ask me how I know. 😭😂 I’ve been importing inventory for years, and learning how to source overseas completely changed the way I was able to grow my rental inventory. So if importing is something you’re seriously considering, learn the process BEFORE you start sending people your money. I put what I’ve learned—including manufacturers I’ve actually sourced from—inside my Luxury Inventory Sourcing Blueprint. Comment IMPORT and I’ll send you the information. 💕 Learn first. Then spend.

Apparently we’re ALL ordering motorized exterior screens from China now 😂 Since so many of you asked for Laura’s information after I shared my quote, here’s the easiest way to get an accurate quote from her: Measure the clear WIDTH of each opening from inside edge to inside edge, then the HEIGHT from where the screen cassette will mount down to where you want the screen to close. Send her each opening separately + how many screens you need. For reference, my order includes 6 motorized ZIP screens, including Big Boy himself at 238 3/8” wide, almost 20 FEET. 😂 That screen alone was quoted at $464, and all 6 screens were $1,311 before packaging/shipping. I also asked Laura about creating a direct product link and potentially a discount for everyone coming from my page because if I’m sending half of TikTok to this woman, we might as well negotiate as a group. 😂 As always: I’m sharing my own sourcing process and quotes as I go. Mine haven’t arrived yet, so I’ll show you EVERYTHING when they do: quality, motors, installation, shipping, and whether this Alibaba House experiment continues to be genius or completely unhinged. 😂 #buyfromchina #Alibaba #motorizedscreens #customhome #homebuildingtips
